guard: The scheduled full sweep is a 12-way fail-fast-disabled Tenki matrix with bounded shard budgets, a named aggregate gate that rejects failed or cancelled shards, and the full alarm depending on that aggregate.

mutations.name: the full matrix cancels siblings after one shard fails
mutations.find:
full_shard:
    # A daily sweep keeps the remaining ambient-drift window bounded without making every pull
    # request pay for the full corpus. The corpus takes roughly 20 hours as one serial process, so
    # the runner's deterministic path hash partitions it across 12 independent mutation trees.
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 240
    runs-on: tenki-standard-medium-4c-8g
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
mutations.replace:
full_shard:
    # A daily sweep keeps the remaining ambient-drift window bounded without making every pull
    # request pay for the full corpus. The corpus takes roughly 20 hours as one serial process, so
    # the runner's deterministic path hash partitions it across 12 independent mutation trees.
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 240
    runs-on: tenki-standard-medium-4c-8g
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
mutations.expectRed: full_shard is a 12-way fail-fast-disabled Tenki matrix
mutations.cell: full_shard is a 12-way fail-fast-disabled Tenki matrix

mutations.name: the full aggregate accepts a failed matrix
the full aggregate accepts a cancelled matrix
the aggregate probe keeps Cotal session variables
mutations.expectRed: aggregate probes do not inherit Cotal session credentials
mutations.cell: aggregate probes do not inherit Cotal session credentials

mutations.name: the full alarm watches shards instead of the aggregate gate
mutations.expectRed: full-alarm remains pointed at the full aggregate gate
mutations.cell: full-alarm remains pointed at the full aggregate gate
